name: Camarillo Premium Outlets
description: Camarillo Premium Outlets is an outdoor shopping destination featuring designer and name-brand outlet stores at discounted prices, located in scenic Ventura County. This open-air outlet center offers a premium shopping experience with a curated selection of fashion, home goods, and lifestyle brands. Shoppers enjoy convenient access from the 101 Freeway with ample parking and year-round California weather perfect for outdoor shopping.
summary: A premier outdoor outlet shopping center featuring over 160 designer and brand-name stores offering exceptional value in the heart of Ventura County.
